urls.rationale: Chapter 305 - Registration of Lobbyists is the Texas lobbying-disclosure statute body.

notes: Subtitle A page exposes chapter-level links. Chapter 305 (Registration of Lobbyists) is the unique lobbying-disclosure chapter; the other chapters (301 Legislative Organization, 302 Speaker, 303 Governor for a Day, 304 Emergency Succession, 306 Legislative Information) are unrelated to lobbying registration / expenditure / gift disclosure.
